answer_summary: 4.2 nuclear reaction equations: (a) 11_5B + 4_2He -> 14_7N + 1_0n; (b) 2_1D + gamma -> 1_1H + 1_0n (photodisintegration of the deuteron); (c) 9_4Be + 4_2He -> 12_6C + 1_0n. Each is forced uniquely by conservation of mass number A and atomic number Z together with the problem's stipulation that each channel produces a neutron.
